title: carphephorus paniculatus
intro: Carphephorus paniculatus, commonly known as Yellowtop, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its use in traditional herbal medicine to alleviate various health conditions. The health benefits of Carphephorus paniculatus include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects.
